name: Wayfair Mastercard®
balance_transfer_apr: 33.74%, for balance transfers completed within 4 months of account opening
balance_transfer_fee: The greater of $10 or 5% of the amount of each transfer

welcome_bonus.requirement: your first Wayfair order of at least $100 (before tax, shipping and other discounts) made with the card; not valid at Perigold, Wayfair outlet stores or on promotional financing orders; offer ends Feb 1, 2027

verdict.text: Strong 7% for Wayfair-family spend, worth it if you furnish a home over time

earn_rates.category: Wayfair, Joss & Main, AllModern, Birch Lane & Perigold sites, apps and stores, excluding outlets (5% instead if using promotional financing on that purchase)

earn_note: This is the open-loop Mastercard version of Wayfair's card: it earns outside the Wayfair family of brands, unlike the closed-loop, store-only Wayfair Credit Card, which earns the same 7%/5% at Wayfair brands but nothing elsewhere. The 3% grocery rate is for stand-alone grocers: food bought at convenience stores, gas stations, warehouse clubs, supercenters and discount stores may earn 1%. The 2% online rate excludes subscriptions, utilities, insurance, medical, education and professional services. Reward Dollars are capped at $2,500 redeemed per month across Wayfair's brands.

redemption_options.method: Applied in cart or at checkout at Wayfair, Joss & Main, AllModern, Birch Lane, or Perigold, online, by phone, or in stores (not outlets)

points.per_100k: Not applicable: Wayfair Rewards accrue and redeem in dollars directly (no separate points conversion), capped at $2,500 redeemable per month
points.note: Reward Dollars have no cash value and can't be redeemed anywhere outside the Wayfair family of brands. They never expire while the account stays open, but they're forfeited 90 days after notice that the account has closed unless you become a paid Wayfair Rewards member. The $2,500/month redemption cap matters for anyone trying to put a large balance toward one big furniture purchase.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: Wayfair Reward Dollars redeem only across the Wayfair family of brands.

insurance.detail: Not confirmed on Citi's or Wayfair's public product pages for this card
Not confirmed on Citi's or Wayfair's public product pages for this card

protection_note: No Guide to Benefits for this card was found, and Citi's product page lists no purchase protection, extended warranty, or travel insurance. That's a real gap for a card built around furniture and home-goods purchases.
rental_note: No rental car coverage found for this card.

services.name: Free Wayfair Rewards membership
services.detail: Cardholders are enrolled in Wayfair Rewards automatically, with the membership fee waived while the card account is open. The card's 7% replaces the 5% a paid member earns; it doesn't add to it.

services.name: Special financing offers
services.detail: Promotional financing plans available across participating Wayfair sites on qualifying items, selectable at checkout; using promotional financing on a purchase drops the earn rate from 7% to 5% on that purchase.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns rewards on their spend (into your account)
No dedicated insurance to share: this card doesn't carry a confirmed protection suite

additional_cards.note: Free to add, useful mainly for pooling a household's home-goods spend toward the 7% category.

timeline.text: Wayfair's credit card program moved from Comenity Bank to Citibank, N.A., which issues both the closed-loop Wayfair Credit Card and this open-loop Wayfair Mastercard.

Wayfair/Citi issue two distinct card products: the closed-loop, store-only Wayfair Credit Card (7%/5% at Wayfair brands, unusable elsewhere) and this open-loop Wayfair Mastercard (same 7%/5% at Wayfair brands, plus 3%/2%/1% elsewhere). Confirm which one you're comparing; they are not the same card.
